resources.string: Off releases the model and audio resources. Activation stays ready until the phone restarts, Sukut updates or Android ends the worker.

In phone Settings → About phone, tap Build number seven times (OS version on Xiaomi) to enable Developer options.
Enable USB debugging, connect a USB data cable and approve your PC on the phone.
On Windows, open Sukut → Phone → Install or update Sukut, then Activate Sukut.
Wait for Audio worker ready here. Choose a mode and press Start. You can unplug USB.
Set up on this phone · Wi-Fi
Use Activate on this phone to pair Sukut through Android Wireless debugging. Windows USB activation remains available.
Wireless setup needs Android 11 or later. Use the PC method on this phone.
